finding.observation: Four append-only Architect packets were committed within 34 seconds, all targeting trigger 4 and all requesting the same ACK-classification-bypass repair, but each used a distinct packet_id/nonce/route identity and therefore was not protected by packet nonce idempotency.
finding.why_it_matters: The current packet protocol correctly prevents one packet from being applied twice, but multiple Architect organs can independently generate different packets for the same semantic coordination boundary. A Trigger-4 consumer can therefore observe multiple individually valid APPLIED candidates for one repair objective, increasing duplicate mutation/fan-out risk unless normal build authority catches the duplication later.

existing_mechanism_reuse.observation: Trigger 7 already has a deterministic create-only semantic objective compiler for research claims. It demonstrates the needed pattern: admitted enum-like semantic identity, stable key, create-only path, and loser routing to a nonduplicate objective. It is not currently integrated into Architect packet emission and its present aliases are mostly voice/research specific.
existing_mechanism_reuse.do_not_do: Do not deduplicate by fuzzy free-text similarity and do not invent a second delivery state machine. Reuse current Clay delivery atomicity/CAS and explicit semantic identities.

preferred_shape: Introduce an explicit coordination_objective identity compiled from admitted non-free-text fields such as project, target selector, coordination family, subject/boundary, evidence scope, and owner-intent epoch.

Before packet creation, perform a create-only/CAS semantic claim using the existing Clay atomicity pattern. The winner may emit the packet; losers must attach to/review the winner instead of creating a new packet.
Keep packet_id/nonce/route_id for delivery idempotency; semantic objective identity is a separate scheduling/deduplication fence, not a truth or delivery authority.
If an equivalent packet is already live, return REVIEW_ONLY/ACK_ONLY evidence with the existing packet/result refs rather than fan-out.
minimum_regressions: two parallel organs with the same admitted coordination objective produce one live packet route
same semantic boundary with paraphrased free text but identical admitted identity still converges to one key
different target or evidence scope does not falsely deduplicate
expired/terminal objective may be superseded only by an explicit next generation/owner epoch
semantic claim loser creates no mutation authority and no runtime dispatch

next_exact_action: Do not emit another duplicate ACK-repair packet. Let normal Trigger-4 authority converge the already-routed repair once. In the Trigger-7 coordination lane, add a semantic singleton fence to packet emission using the existing deterministic semantic-claim/create-only pattern, then rerun the same parallel-injection experiment and require exactly one live packet route.
